

send_child_to_holy_order_tooltip_effect = {
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = order_member
		add_piety_level = 1
		custom_tooltip = character_will_leave_court_holy_order
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_married = yes
			}
			every_spouse = {
				divorce = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = betrothed
			}
			break_betrothal = betrothed
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_been_promised_grand_wedding = yes
				}
				break_grand_wedding_betrothal_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_concubine = yes
			}
			this.concubinist = {
				remove_concubine = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				number_of_concubines > 0
			}
			every_concubine = {
				scope:recipient = {
					remove_concubine = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

send_child_to_holy_order_effect = {
	$GRANDMASTER$ = {
		add_courtier = scope:recipient
		if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    is_close_family_of = scope:actor
                    NOT = {
                    	has_trait = bastard
                    }
                }
            }
            add_opinion = {
                target = scope:actor
                modifier = pleased_opinion
                opinion = 25
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    is_close_family_of = scope:actor
                }
            }
            add_opinion = {
                target = scope:actor
                modifier = pleased_opinion
                opinion = 15
            }
        }
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = order_member
		add_piety_level = 1
		if = {
			limit = { is_ruler = yes }
			depose = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				faith != $GRANDMASTER$.faith
			}
			set_character_faith = $GRANDMASTER$.faith
			set_character_rite = $GRANDMASTER$.rite
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_married = yes
			}
			every_spouse = {
				divorce = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = betrothed
			}
			break_betrothal = betrothed
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_been_promised_grand_wedding = yes
				}
				break_grand_wedding_betrothal_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_concubine = yes
			}
			this.concubinist = {
				remove_concubine = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				number_of_concubines > 0
			}
			every_concubine = {
				scope:recipient = {
					remove_concubine = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
	take_vows_faith_opinion_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			$GRANDMASTER$ = {
				has_realm_law = cultural_holy_order_succession_law
				NOT = {
					culture = {
						has_same_culture_heritage = scope:recipient.culture
					}
				}
			}
		}
		$GRANDMASTER$ = { save_scope_as = grandmaster }
		custom_tooltip = military_order_wrong_culture_tt
	}
}

send_child_to_clergy_effect = {
	scope:recipient = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_character_flag = pam_simony_paid_vows }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						scope:demand ?= yes
						AND = {
							is_imprisoned_by = scope:puppet_or_actor
							OR = {
								is_heir_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
								any_claim = {
									exists = this
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add_opinion = {
					modifier = forced_taking_vows
					target = scope:puppet_or_actor
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_opinion = {
					modifier = demanded_taking_vows
					target = scope:puppet_or_actor
				}
			}
		}
		simplified_clergy_effect = { RECIPIENT = scope:recipient }
	}
	scope:puppet_or_actor = {
		#Spiritual fulfillment gain
   		if = {
   			limit = {
   				scope:recipient = {
    	            is_child_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
    	            NOT = {
    	        		has_trait = bastard
    	        	}
    	        }
   			}
   			change_spiritual_fulfillment = {
   				value = medium_spiritual_fulfillment_value
   				if = {
   					limit = {
   						scope:recipient = {
   							is_imprisoned = yes
   						}
   					}
   					multiply = 0.5
   				}
   			}
   		}
   		else_if = {
   			limit = {
   				scope:recipient = {
    	            trigger_if = {
    	            	limit = {
    	            		has_trait = bastard
    	            	}
    	            	is_child_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
    	            }
    	            OR = {
    	            	house ?= scope:puppet_or_actor.house
    	            	is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
    	            }
    	        }
   			}
   			change_spiritual_fulfillment = {
   				value = minor_spiritual_fulfillment_value
   				if = {
   					limit = {
   						scope:recipient = {
   							is_imprisoned = yes
   						}
   					}
   					multiply = 0.5
   				}
   			}
   		}
   		else_if = {
   			limit = {
   				scope:recipient = {
    	            trigger_if = {
    	            	limit = {
    	            		has_trait = bastard
    	            	}
    	            	OR = {
    	            		house ?= scope:puppet_or_actor.house
    	            		is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
    	           		}
    	            }
    	            trigger_else = {
    	            	OR = {
    	            		dynasty ?= scope:puppet_or_actor.dynasty
    	            		is_close_or_extended_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
    	            	}
    	            }
    	        }
   			}
   			change_spiritual_fulfillment = {
   				value = miniscule_spiritual_fulfillment_value
   				if = {
   					limit = {
   						scope:recipient = {
   							is_imprisoned = yes
   						}
   					}
   					multiply = 0.5
   				}
   			}
   		}
   		else = {
   			change_spiritual_fulfillment = {
   				value = miniscule_spiritual_fulfillment_value
   				multiply = 0.5
   				if = {
   					limit = {
   						scope:recipient = {
   							is_imprisoned = yes
   						}
   					}
   					multiply = 0.5
   				}
   			}
   		}
	}
}



simplified_clergy_effect = {
	$RECIPIENT$ = {
		# Full monastic vows supersede a deacon's ordination
		remove_trait = cleric
		add_trait = devoted
		add_piety_level = 1
		if = {
			limit = { is_ruler = yes }
			depose = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_married = yes
			}
			every_spouse = {
				divorce = $RECIPIENT$
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = betrothed
			}
			break_betrothal = betrothed
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_been_promised_grand_wedding = yes
				}
				break_grand_wedding_betrothal_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_concubine = yes
			}
			this.concubinist = {
				remove_concubine = $RECIPIENT$
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				number_of_concubines > 0
			}
			every_concubine = {
				$RECIPIENT$ = {
					remove_concubine = prev
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

release_as_executioner_effect = {
	scope:actor = {
		court_position_grant_effect = {
			EMPLOYER = scope:actor
			POS = executioner
			CANDIDATE = scope:recipient
		}
		save_scope_as = liege
	}
}

create_monastic_decision_effect = {
	save_scope_as = root_scope
	custom_tooltip = create_monastic_order_decision_effect_message_tenet
	custom_tooltip = create_monastic_order_decision_effect_message
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_realm_law = church_authority_1
				has_realm_law = church_authority_2
				has_realm_law = church_authority_3
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = create_monastic_order_gain_hook
	}
	custom_tooltip = create_monastic_order_decision_effect_message_warning

	change_spiritual_fulfillment = medium_spiritual_fulfillment_value
	stress_impact = {
		zealous = minor_stress_impact_loss
		impatient = miniscule_stress_impact_gain
		patient = miniscule_stress_impact_loss
		calm = miniscule_stress_impact_loss
	}

	if = { # If you have no valid barony this will throw errors when you open the decision - we add this check to avoid that 
		limit = {
			exists = scope:title
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:title = {
				ordered_county_province = {
					order_by = {
						value = 0
						if = {
							limit = {
								OR = {
									terrain = hills
									terrain = mountains
									terrain = desert_mountains
									terrain = desert
								}
							}
							add = 2
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								OR = {
									terrain = forest
									terrain = drylands
									terrain = wetlands
									terrain = jungle
									terrain = terraced_hills
								}
							}
							add = 1
						}
					}
					limit = {
						has_holding = no
						has_ongoing_construction = no
					}
					begin_create_holding = church_holding
					save_scope_as = province
					set_variable = {
						name = monastic_order_capital
						value = root.faith
						years = 50
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_event = holy_order.2009
}

create_monastic_order_leader_and_notification_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:chosen_leader
		}
		scope:chosen_leader = {
			save_scope_as = new_monastic_leader
		}
	}
	else = {
		scope:leader = { save_scope_as = new_monastic_leader }
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { # set up currencies for the HO leader, has to be saved as scope:leader
			limit = {
				exists = scope:new_monastic_leader
			}
			scope:new_monastic_leader = {
				set_variable = founding_monastic
			}
			scope:new_holy_order.leader.primary_title = {
				set_variable = {
					name = founder
					value = scope:founder
				}
			}
			#If we have to transfer Order from default leader to someone else
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:new_monastic_leader = {
						has_character_flag = created_char
					}
				}
				scope:new_monastic_leader = {
					remove_character_flag = created_char
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						scope:new_holy_order.leader ?= scope:new_monastic_leader 
					}
				}
				scope:new_holy_order.leader.primary_title = {
					create_title_and_vassal_change = {
						type = granted
						save_scope_as = change
						add_claim_on_loss = yes
					}
					change_title_holder_include_vassals = {
						holder = scope:new_monastic_leader
						change = scope:change
					}
					resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
				}
				scope:new_monastic_leader = {
					every_courtier = {
						add_trait = devoted
					}
				}
				
			}
			
			scope:new_monastic_leader = {
				add_gold = 100 #So that they have some money to lend out
				add_piety_level = 2
				add_gold = holy_order_starting_gold
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = grabbed_monks
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						this = scope:new_monastic_leader
						is_courtier_of = scope:new_monastic_leader
					}
				}
				scope:new_monastic_leader = { add_courtier = prev }
				remove_character_flag = created_char
			}
			
			# send messages
			send_interface_toast = {
				type = monastic_holy_order_founded_message
				desc = i_created_monastic_holy_order_message
				custom_tooltip = monastic_order_tenet_advocated_tt
				left_icon = scope:new_monastic_leader
				right_icon = scope:new_holy_order.title
			}
		}
		# send messages to relevant characters that HO got created
		save_scope_as = holy_order_creator
		every_player = {
			limit = {
				faith = scope:holy_order_creator.faith
				this != scope:holy_order_creator
			}
			send_interface_message = {
				type = monastic_holy_order_founded_message
				desc = someone_created_monastic_holy_order_message
				custom_tooltip = monastic_order_tenet_advocated_tt
				left_icon = scope:holy_order_creator
				right_icon = scope:new_holy_order.title
			}
		}
	}
}

create_monastic_order_founder_effect = {
	# gain opinion with your HoF, if you have one and it's not you
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = faith.religious_head
			faith.religious_head != root
		}
		faith.religious_head = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = root
				modifier = founded_monastic_order_opinion
				opinion = 20
			}
		}
	}
	# get a nice modifier
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_character_modifier = founded_monastic_order_modifier }
		}
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = founded_monastic_order_modifier
			years = 5
		}
	}
	# boost the fervor
	faith = {
		change_fervor = {
			value = notable_fervor_gain
			desc = fervor_gain_monastic_order_founded
		}
	}

	change_spiritual_fulfillment = minor_spiritual_fulfillment_value

	scope:leader = {
		save_scope_as = order_master
	}

	create_character_memory = {
		type = founded_monastic_order_memory
		participants = {
			order_master = scope:leader
		}
	}

	# PAM - Catalysts
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_pam_dlc_trigger = yes
			religion = religion:christianity_religion
			situation:the_christian_church ?= {
				situation_top_has_catalyst = catalyst_the_christian_church_founded_monastic_order
			}
		}
		situation:the_christian_church = {
			trigger_situation_catalyst = catalyst_the_christian_church_founded_monastic_order
		}
	}
}

grab_best_monk_for_tenet_effect = {
	$TENET$ = {
		save_scope_as = monk_grabbin_tenet
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = dynasty
		}
		dynasty = {
			ordered_dynasty_member = {
				order_by = learning
				#Family member courtier
				limit = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:founder
					house ?= scope:founder.house
					is_courtier_of = scope:founder
					potential_abbot_trigger = yes
					OR = {
						rite = {
							rite_has_tenet = scope:monk_grabbin_tenet
						}
						has_personal_tenet = scope:monk_grabbin_tenet
					}
				}
				#Family member
				alternative_limit = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:founder
					house ?= scope:founder.house
					is_ruler = no
					in_diplomatic_range = scope:founder
					potential_abbot_trigger = yes
					#Don't steal players' courtiers
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							is_courtier = yes
							NOT = {
								is_courtier_of = scope:founder
							}
						}
						NOT = {
							liege = {
								is_ai = no
							}
						}
					}
				}
				#House member courtier
				alternative_limit = {
					house ?= scope:founder.house
					is_courtier_of = scope:founder
					potential_abbot_trigger = yes
				}
				#House member
				alternative_limit = {
					house ?= scope:founder.house
					is_ruler = no
					in_diplomatic_range = scope:founder
					potential_abbot_trigger = yes
					#Don't steal players' courtiers
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							is_courtier = yes
							NOT = {
								is_courtier_of = scope:founder
							}
						}
						NOT = {
							liege = {
								is_ai = no
							}
						}
					}
				}
				#dynasty member courtier
				alternative_limit = {
					is_courtier_of = scope:founder
					potential_abbot_trigger = yes
				}
				#Dynasty member
				alternative_limit = {
					is_ruler = no
					in_diplomatic_range = scope:founder
					potential_abbot_trigger = yes
					#Don't steal players' courtiers
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							is_courtier = yes
							NOT = {
								is_courtier_of = scope:founder
							}
						}
						NOT = {
							liege = {
								is_ai = no
							}
						}
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = abbot_prospect
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:abbot_prospect
			}
		}
		#Grab monk courtiers ordered by family importance
		ordered_courtier = {
			order_by = learning
			#Bastards first
			limit = {
				is_close_family_of = scope:founder
				potential_abbot_trigger = yes
			}
			#friends
			alternative_limit = {
				has_any_good_relationship_with_character_trigger = { CHARACTER = scope:founder }
				potential_abbot_trigger = yes
			}
			alternative_limit = {
				potential_abbot_trigger = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = abbot_prospect
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				exists = scope:abbot_prospect
			}
		}
		random_list = {
			#male monk that belongs to local culture
			2 = {
				trigger = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:leader.primary_title
						}
						scope:leader.primary_title = {
							NOT = { has_variable = female_order }
						}
					}
				}
				#Create newly-generated option
				create_character = {
					template = monastic_order_leader_character
					culture = scope:barony.county.culture
					location = scope:founder.location
					gender = male
					save_scope_as = abbot_prospect
				}
			}
			#male lowborn monk that belongs to local culture
			2 = {
				trigger = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:leader.primary_title
						}
						scope:leader.primary_title = {
							NOT = { has_variable = female_order }
						}
					}
				}
				#Create newly-generated option
				create_character = {
					template = monastic_order_leader_character
					dynasty = none
					culture = scope:barony.county.culture
					location = scope:founder.location
					gender = male
					save_scope_as = abbot_prospect
				}
			}
			#male lowborn monk that belongs to founder culture
			1 = {
				trigger = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:leader.primary_title
						}
						scope:leader.primary_title = {
							NOT = { has_variable = female_order }
						}
					}
				}
				#Create newly-generated option
				create_character = {
					template = monastic_order_leader_character
					dynasty = none
					culture = scope:barony.county.culture
					location = scope:founder.location
					gender = male
					save_scope_as = abbot_prospect
				}
			}
			#male monk that belongs to founder culture
			1 = {
				trigger = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:leader.primary_title
						}
						scope:leader.primary_title = {
							NOT = { has_variable = female_order }
						}
					}
				}
				#Create newly-generated option
				create_character = {
					template = monastic_order_leader_character
					culture = scope:barony.county.culture
					location = scope:founder.location
					gender = male
					save_scope_as = abbot_prospect
				}
			}
			#female nun that belongs to local culture
			2 = {
				trigger = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:leader.primary_title
						}
						scope:leader.primary_title = {
							NOT = { has_variable = male_order }
						}
					}
				}
				#Create newly-generated option
				create_character = {
					template = monastic_order_leader_character
					culture = scope:barony.county.culture
					location = scope:founder.location
					gender = female
					save_scope_as = abbot_prospect
				}
			}

			#female nun that belongs to founder culture
			1 = {
				trigger = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
							exists = scope:leader.primary_title
						}
						scope:leader.primary_title = {
							NOT = { has_variable = male_order }
						}
					}
				}
				#Create newly-generated option
				create_character = {
					template = monastic_order_leader_character
					culture = scope:barony.county.culture
					location = scope:founder.location
					gender = female
					save_scope_as = abbot_prospect
				}
			}
		}
		scope:abbot_prospect = {
			add_character_flag = {
				flag = created_char
				days = 60
			}
		}
	}
	scope:abbot_prospect = {
		add_to_list = grabbed_monks
	}
}
pick_monastic_founder_option_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:monastic_order
		}
		custom_tooltip = monastic_tenet_pick_tt
	}
	else = {
		custom_tooltip = monastic_tenet_pick_unformed_order_tt
	}
	# holy_order.2009 stored the founder boost on the province until this order title existed
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:monastic_order
			scope:barony.title_province ?= { has_variable = new_order_ascetic_boost }
		}
		scope:barony.title_province = {
			var:new_order_ascetic_boost = { save_temporary_scope_as = new_order_ascetic_founder }
			remove_variable = new_order_ascetic_boost
		}
		scope:monastic_order = {
			set_variable = {
				name = ascetic_order_founder
				value = scope:new_order_ascetic_founder
				years = 50
			}
		}
	}
	#Gain popularity if taking holding from old order
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:target_order_tenet
		}
		faith = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_tenet_popularity_trigger = yes }
				if = {
					limit = {
						list_size = {
							name = revoked_leases
							value >= 5
						}
					}
					change_tenet_popularity = {
						target = scope:tenet_pick
						change = {
							value = medium_tenet_popularity_gain
							multiply = 4
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						list_size = {
							name = revoked_leases
							value >= 4
						}
					}
					change_tenet_popularity = {
						target = scope:tenet_pick
						change = {
							value = medium_tenet_popularity_gain
							multiply = 3
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						list_size = {
							name = revoked_leases
							value >= 3
						}
					}
					change_tenet_popularity = {
						target = scope:tenet_pick
						change = {
							value = medium_tenet_popularity_gain
							multiply = 2
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						list_size = {
							name = revoked_leases
							value >= 2
						}
					}
					change_tenet_popularity = {
						target = scope:tenet_pick
						change = {
							value = medium_tenet_popularity_gain
							multiply = 1.5
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					change_tenet_popularity = {
						target = scope:tenet_pick
						change = {
							value = medium_tenet_popularity_gain
							multiply = 1
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		
		if = {
			limit = {
				rite = {
					OR = {
						has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_dulia status = core }
						has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_dulia status = permitted }
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = monastic_founder_become_saint_tt
		}
		#Reward high church authority theocrat with a hook
		if = {
			limit = {
				root = {
					OR = {
						has_realm_law = church_authority_1
						has_realm_law = church_authority_2
						has_realm_law = church_authority_3
					}
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			add_hook = {
				type = indebted_hook
				target = scope:chosen_leader
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:target_lessee
		}
		scope:target_lessee = {
			set_relation_rival = {
				target = scope:chosen_leader
				reason = rival_shattered_order
			}
		}
	}
}

take_vows_demand_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = {
				is_heir_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
			}
		}
		add_tyranny = medium_tyranny_gain
	}
	
	scope:recipient = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_relation_rival = scope:puppet_or_actor
				}
				OR = {
					ai_zeal <= low_negative_ai_value
					ai_greed >= low_positive_ai_value
					ai_vengefulness >= low_positive_ai_value
				}
				NOR = {
					has_trait = forgiving
					has_trait = craven
					has_trait = zealous
					has_trait = content
					has_trait = humble
					has_trait = bastard
				}
			}
			set_relation_rival = {
				target = scope:puppet_or_actor
				reason = rival_forced_to_take_vows
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					#Bastards with decently matching personality don't see this as betrayal
					NAND = {
						has_trait = bastard
						ai_vengefulness < low_positive_ai_value
						ai_greed < low_positive_ai_value
						ai_zeal > low_negative_ai_value
					}
				}
				progress_towards_rival_effect = {
					CHARACTER = scope:puppet_or_actor
					REASON = rival_forced_to_take_vows
					OPINION = 0
				}
			}
		}
		every_parent = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					this = scope:puppet_or_actor
					#Doesn't have other kid in root's line succession
					any_child = {
						NOT = {
							this = scope:recipient
						}
						is_heir_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
					}
					has_trait = zealous
				}
			}
			add_opinion = {
				modifier = forced_child_take_vows
				target = scope:puppet_or_actor
			}
		}
	}
}

send_child_to_monastic_order_effect = {
   	# Legitimacy loss if you're doing this to your children
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_legitimacy = yes
			scope:recipient = { is_primary_heir_of = scope:puppet_or_actor }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				hyperdulia_take_the_vows_trigger = yes
			}
			add_legitimacy = {
				value = miniscule_legitimacy_gain
				multiply = scope:puppet_or_actor.primary_title.tier
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_legitimacy = {
				value = minor_legitimacy_loss
				multiply = scope:puppet_or_actor.primary_title.tier
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_legitimacy = yes
			scope:recipient = { is_heir_of = scope:puppet_or_actor }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				hyperdulia_take_the_vows_trigger = yes
			}
			add_legitimacy = {
				value = minor_legitimacy_gain
				multiply = scope:puppet_or_actor.primary_title.tier
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_legitimacy = {
				value = miniscule_legitimacy_loss
				multiply = scope:puppet_or_actor.primary_title.tier
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_legitimacy = yes
			hyperdulia_take_the_vows_trigger = yes
		}
		add_legitimacy = {
			value = medium_legitimacy_gain
			multiply = scope:puppet_or_actor.primary_title.tier
		}
	}

   	#Spiritual fulfillment gain
   	if = {
   		limit = {
   			scope:recipient = {
                is_child_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
                NOT = {
            		has_trait = bastard
            	}
            }
   		}
   		change_spiritual_fulfillment = {
   			value = major_spiritual_fulfillment_value
   			if = {
   				limit = {
   					scope:recipient = {
   						is_imprisoned = yes
   					}
   				}
   				multiply = 0.5
   			}
   		}
   	}
   	else_if = {
   		limit = {
   			scope:recipient = {
                trigger_if = {
                	limit = {
                		has_trait = bastard
                	}
                	is_child_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
                }
                OR = {
                	house ?= scope:puppet_or_actor.house
                	is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
                }
            }
   		}
   		change_spiritual_fulfillment = {
   			value = medium_spiritual_fulfillment_value
   			if = {
   				limit = {
   					scope:recipient = {
   						is_imprisoned = yes
   					}
   				}
   				multiply = 0.5
   			}
   		}
   	}
   	else_if = {
   		limit = {
   			scope:recipient = {
                trigger_if = {
                	limit = {
                		has_trait = bastard
                	}
                	OR = {
                		house ?= scope:puppet_or_actor.house
                		is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
               		}
                }
                trigger_else = {
                	OR = {
                		dynasty ?= scope:puppet_or_actor.dynasty
                		is_close_or_extended_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
                	}
                }
            }
   		}
   		change_spiritual_fulfillment = {
   			value = minor_spiritual_fulfillment_value
   			if = {
   				limit = {
   					scope:recipient = {
   						is_imprisoned = yes
   					}
   				}
   				multiply = 0.5
   			}
   		}
   	}
   	else = {
   		change_spiritual_fulfillment = {
   			value = miniscule_spiritual_fulfillment_value
   			if = {
   				limit = {
   					scope:recipient = {
   						is_imprisoned = yes
   					}
   				}
   				multiply = 0.5
   			}
   		}
   	}
   

    #Send to holy order if we can, if not... make just rando monk in a bishop's court
    scope:archabbot = {
        add_courtier = scope:recipient
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
                    NOT = {
                    	has_trait = bastard
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
                }
            }
            add_opinion = {
                target = scope:puppet_or_actor
                modifier = pleased_opinion
                opinion = 15
            }
        }
        if = {
        	limit = {
        		scope:recipient = {
        			OR = {
                		house ?= scope:puppet_or_actor.house
                		is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
               		}
        		}
        	}
        	dynastic_monks_gain_xp_effect = yes
        }
    }

    scope:recipient = {
        add_trait = devoted
        add_piety_level = 1
        if = {
            limit = { is_ruler = yes }
            depose = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                is_married = yes
            }
            every_spouse = {
                divorce = scope:recipient
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = betrothed
            }
            break_betrothal = betrothed
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_been_promised_grand_wedding = yes
                }
                break_grand_wedding_betrothal_effect = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                is_concubine = yes
            }
            this.concubinist = {
                remove_concubine = scope:recipient
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                number_of_concubines > 0
            }
            every_concubine = {
                scope:recipient = {
                    remove_concubine = prev
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            house = {
                has_house_aspiration_parameter = humility_take_the_vows_bonus
            }
        }
        add_piety_experience = 100
        add_character_modifier = {
            modifier = tgp_humility_take_the_vows_bonus_modifier
            years = 10
        }
    }
}
take_vows_faith_opinion_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
			scope:recipient = {
				is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
				NOT = {
              		has_trait = bastard
              	}
			}
		}
		cp:councillor_court_chaplain = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:puppet_or_actor
				modifier = pious_opinion
				opinion = 20
			}
		}
	}
	#bastards
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = cp:councillor_court_chaplain
			scope:recipient = {
				is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
			}
		}
		cp:councillor_court_chaplain = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:puppet_or_actor
				modifier = pious_opinion
				opinion = 10
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = faith.religious_head
			faith.religious_head != scope:puppet_or_actor
			scope:recipient = {
				is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
				NOT = {
              		has_trait = bastard
              	}
			}
		}
		faith.religious_head = {
			add_opinion = {
				target = scope:puppet_or_actor
				modifier = pious_opinion
				opinion = 10
			}
		}
	}
}

military_order_yearly_trait_gain_effect = {
	#Lazarites might gain a little leprosy...
	if = {
		limit = {
			primary_title = title:d_knights_of_st_lazarus
		}
		random = {
			chance = 10
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_trait = leper }
				}
				add_to_list = lazarists
			}
			every_courtier = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_trait = leper }
				}
			}
			random_in_list = {
				list = lazarists
				add_trait = leper
			}
		}
	}
	#Hospital orders gain physician trait XP
	if = {
		limit = {
			primary_title = {
				OR = {
					this = title:d_knights_of_st_lazarus
					this = title:d_knights_hospitaller
					this = title:d_knights_of_the_tau
				}
			}
		}
		every_courtier = {
			limit = {
				has_trait = lifestyle_physician
			}
			add_trait_xp = {
				trait = lifestyle_physician
				value = { 1 10 }
			}
		}
		random = {
			chance = 50
			ordered_courtier = {
				order_by = learning
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_trait = lifestyle_physician
					}
				}
				add_trait = lifestyle_physician
			}
		}
	}
}
set_up_historical_monastic_orders_effect = {

	#BENEDICTINES
	if = {

		}
		title:b_cassino = { # Montecassino
			save_scope_as = monastic_barony

				set_variable = {
					name = monastic_game_start_founder

				}

	#Camaldolese
	#Hermit congregation founded by St Romuald at Camaldoli in the Casentino

		}

			limit = { game_start_date >= 1286.3.15 }
			character:MB_camaldoli_gerardo = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Gerardo, prior general of Camaldoli
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1258.2.15 }
			character:MB_camaldoli_martino_iii = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Martino III, prior general of Camaldoli
		}

############################################################################################### Iberian Cistercians


	##Iberian Cistercians
	#The Cistercians of Portugal and the west of Spain, from Sao Joao de Tarouca, the first house in Portugal to follow Citeaux, to Alcobaca, the great abbey given to Bernard of Clairvaux by Afonso Henriques in 1153
	if = {
		limit = {
			game_start_date >= 1144.10.1
		}
		title:b_viseu = { # Sao Joao de Tarouca and Alcobaca
			save_scope_as = monastic_barony
			county.holder = {
				save_scope_as = game_start_founder
				set_variable = {
					name = monastic_game_start_founder
					days = 10
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = iberian_cistercian_founder
					days = 10
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1337.5.24 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_joao_martins = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Joao Martins, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1300.9.10 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_pedro_nunes = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Pedro Nunes, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1286.3.15 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_martinho_ii = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Martinho II, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1258.2.15 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_estevao_martins = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Estevao Martins, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1246.6.13 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_fernando_eanes = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Fernando Eanes, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1211.6.16 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_fernando_mendes = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Fernando Mendes, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1204.5.16 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_mendo = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Mendo, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1194.9.30 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_mendo = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Mendo, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1187.7.3 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_martinho = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Martinho, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1178.10.1 }
			character:MB_alcobaca_martinho = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Martinho, abbot of Alcobaca
		}
		else = {
			character:MB_tarouca_joao = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Joao, abbot of Sao Joao de Tarouca
		}
		scope:game_start_founder = {
			create_holy_order_neutral_effect = {
				LEADER = scope:monastic_leader
				CAPITAL = scope:monastic_barony
				NEW_HO_SCOPE = new_holy_order
				FOUNDER = scope:game_start_founder
				ORDER_TYPE = monastic
			}
		}
		scope:monastic_leader = {
			#Add the monks of Alcobaca as courtiers
			if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1286.3.15
					game_start_date < 1300.9.10
				}
				add_courtier = character:MB_alcobaca_estevao_martins # Estevao Martins, twice abbot of Alcobaca
				add_courtier = character:MB_alcobaca_pedro_nunes # Pedro Nunes, former and future abbot of Alcobaca
			}
			every_courtier = {
				add_trait = devoted
				add_trait_xp = {
					trait = devoted
					value = { 20 80 }
				}
			}
			faith = {
				random_faith_holy_order = {
					limit = {
						leader = scope:monastic_leader
					}
					save_scope_as = iberian_cistercian
				}
			}
		}
		#Lease out additional holdings
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:iberian_cistercian }
			if = {
				limit = { game_start_date >= 1178.10.1 }
				title:b_melide = { title:c_lugo.holder = { get_title = prev } lease_out_to_holy_order = scope:iberian_cistercian } # Sobrado
				title:b_alba = { title:c_benavente.holder = { get_title = prev } lease_out_to_holy_order = scope:iberian_cistercian } # Moreruela
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { game_start_date >= 1144.10.1 }
				title:b_melide = { title:c_lugo.holder = { get_title = prev } lease_out_to_holy_order = scope:iberian_cistercian } # Sobrado, which joined Clairvaux in 1142
			}
		}
	}

############################################################################################### Céli Dé


	##Celi De
	#The celi De, the clients of God, the ascetic reform of Mael Ruain of Tallaght, with communities at Tallaght, Finglas, Terryglass, Armagh, Clonmacnoise and the island of Loch Cre by Roscrea
	if = {
		limit = {
			game_start_date >= 867.1.1
			game_start_date < 1178.10.1
		}
		title:b_roscrea = { # Inis Locha Cre (Monaincha)
			save_scope_as = monastic_barony
			county.holder = {
				save_scope_as = game_start_founder
				set_variable = {
					name = monastic_game_start_founder
					days = 10
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = celi_de_founder
					days = 10
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1144.10.1 }
			character:MB_celi_de_mael_morda = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Mael Morda mac Uareirge, head of the celi De of Clonmacnoise
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1081.4.1 }
			character:MB_celi_de_mac_mael_dalua = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Mac Mael Dalua, chief soul-friend of all Ireland
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1066.9.15 }
			character:MB_celi_de_cele = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Cele mac Donnacain, head of the piety of Ireland
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1018.8.1 }
			character:MB_celi_de_conn = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Conn na mBocht, head of the celi De of Clonmacnoise
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 936.8.7 }
			character:MB_celi_de_mael_domnaig = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Mael Domnaig, abbot of Tallaght
		}
		else = {
			character:MB_celi_de_comgan = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Comgan Fota, anchorite of Tallaght
		}
		scope:game_start_founder = {
			create_holy_order_neutral_effect = {
				LEADER = scope:monastic_leader
				CAPITAL = scope:monastic_barony
				NEW_HO_SCOPE = new_holy_order
				FOUNDER = scope:game_start_founder
				ORDER_TYPE = monastic
			}
		}
		scope:monastic_leader = {
			#Add the celi De as courtiers
			if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 867.1.1
					game_start_date < 936.8.7
				}
				add_courtier = character:MB_celi_de_macoige # Macoige, abbot of Tallaght
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1066.9.15
					game_start_date < 1081.4.1
				}
				add_courtier = character:MB_celi_de_cumuscach # Cumuscach Ua hErodain, head of the poor of Ireland at Armagh
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1081.4.1
					game_start_date < 1144.10.1
				}
				add_courtier = character:MB_celi_de_fergal # Fergal, senior of Inis Locha Cre
			}
			every_courtier = {
				add_trait = devoted
				add_trait_xp = {
					trait = devoted
					value = { 20 80 }
				}
			}
			faith = {
				random_faith_holy_order = {
					limit = {
						leader = scope:monastic_leader
					}
					save_scope_as = celi_de
				}
			}
		}
	}


############################################################################################### Canons of Santa Cruz


	##Canons of Santa Cruz
	#The canons regular of Santa Cruz at Coimbra, founded in 1131 under the patronage of Afonso Henriques, burial church of the first kings of Portugal and mother of the cruzio houses such as Sao Vicente de Fora at Lisbon
	if = {
		limit = {
			game_start_date >= 1144.10.1
		}
		title:b_cantanhede = { # Santa Cruz of Coimbra
			save_scope_as = monastic_barony
			county.holder = {
				save_scope_as = game_start_founder
				set_variable = {
					name = monastic_game_start_founder
					days = 10
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = santa_cruz_founder
					days = 10
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1337.5.24 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_francisco = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Francisco Pires, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1300.9.10 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_pedro = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Pedro, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1286.3.15 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_durando = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Durando Pais, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1258.2.15 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_martinho = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Martinho, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1246.6.13 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_martinho = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Martinho, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1211.6.16 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_joao_cesar = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Joao Cesar, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1204.5.16 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_joao_cesar = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Joao Cesar, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1194.9.30 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_joao_frois = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Joao Frois, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1187.7.3 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_pedro_alfarde = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Pedro Alfarde, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1178.10.1 }
			character:MB_santa_cruz_joao_teotonio = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Joao Teotonio, prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		else = {
			character:MB_santa_cruz_teotonio = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # St Teotonio, first prior of Santa Cruz of Coimbra
		}
		scope:game_start_founder = {
			create_holy_order_neutral_effect = {
				LEADER = scope:monastic_leader
				CAPITAL = scope:monastic_barony
				NEW_HO_SCOPE = new_holy_order
				FOUNDER = scope:game_start_founder
				ORDER_TYPE = monastic
			}
		}
		scope:monastic_leader = {
			#Add the canons of Santa Cruz as courtiers
			if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1144.10.1
					game_start_date < 1178.10.1
				}
				add_courtier = character:MB_santa_cruz_joao_teotonio # Joao Teotonio, nephew of St Teotonio and later prior
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1178.10.1
					game_start_date < 1187.7.3
				}
				add_courtier = character:MB_santa_cruz_pedro_alfarde # Pedro Alfarde, later prior
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1204.5.16
					game_start_date < 1211.6.16
				}
				add_courtier = character:MB_santa_cruz_diogo_dias # Diogo Dias, nephew of Prior Joao Cesar
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1211.6.16
					game_start_date < 1246.6.13
				}
				add_courtier = character:MB_santa_cruz_diogo_dias # Diogo Dias, nephew of Prior Joao Cesar
				add_courtier = character:MB_santa_cruz_fernando # Fernando Martins of Lisbon, canon of Sao Vicente de Fora, later St Anthony of Padua
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1246.6.13
					game_start_date < 1258.2.15
				}
				add_courtier = character:MB_santa_cruz_goncalo_mendes # Goncalo Mendes, prior of Sao Vicente de Fora
			}
			every_courtier = {
				add_trait = devoted
				add_trait_xp = {
					trait = devoted
					value = { 20 80 }
				}
			}
			faith = {
				random_faith_holy_order = {
					limit = {
						leader = scope:monastic_leader
					}
					save_scope_as = santa_cruz
				}
			}
		}
	}

############################################################################################### Studites


	#Studites
	#The monastery of Stoudios in Constantinople, reformed by St Theodore the Studite from 798; his rule spread across the Byzantine world and to the Rus. Sacked in 1204 and deserted under the Latins, it was restored by Constantine Palaiologos c. 1290-1293
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					game_start_date >= 867.1.1
					game_start_date < 1204.5.16
				}
				game_start_date >= 1300.9.10
			}
		}
		title:b_herakleiaperinthos = { # Stoudios
			save_scope_as = monastic_barony
			county.holder = {
				save_scope_as = game_start_founder
				set_variable = {
					name = monastic_game_start_founder
					days = 10
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = studite_founder
					days = 10
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1337.5.24 }
			character:MB_stoudios_neophytos = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Neophytos, hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1300.9.10 }
			character:MB_stoudios_theoktistos = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Theoktistos, hegumen of the restored Stoudios
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1194.9.30 }
			character:MB_stoudios_gerasimos = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Gerasimos, hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1187.7.3 }
			character:MB_stoudios_gerasimos = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Gerasimos, hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1178.10.1 }
			character:MB_stoudios_ioannikios = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Ioannikios, hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1144.10.1 }
			character:MB_stoudios_theophylaktos = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Theophylaktos, hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1081.4.1 }
			character:studite_2 = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Niketas Stethatos, hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1066.9.15 }
			character:MB_stoudios_michael = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Michael, synkellos and hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 1018.8.1 }
			character:melkite_031 = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Nicholas, hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { game_start_date >= 936.8.7 }
			character:MB_stoudios_anatolios = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Anatolios, hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		else = {
			character:MB_stoudios_sabas = { save_scope_as = monastic_leader } # Sabas, hegumen of Stoudios
		}
		scope:game_start_founder = {
			create_holy_order_neutral_effect = {
				LEADER = scope:monastic_leader
				CAPITAL = scope:monastic_barony
				NEW_HO_SCOPE = new_holy_order
				FOUNDER = scope:game_start_founder
				ORDER_TYPE = monastic
			}
		}
		scope:monastic_leader = {
			#Add now-unneeded abbots as courtiers
			if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1066.9.15
					game_start_date < 1081.4.1
				}
				add_courtier = character:studite_2 # Niketas Stethatos, monk of Stoudios and biographer of Symeon the New Theologian
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 1018.8.1
					game_start_date < 1066.9.15
				}
				add_courtier = character:70542 # Alexios, monk of Stoudios and later hegumen and Patriarch
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					game_start_date >= 867.1.1
					game_start_date < 936.8.7
				}
				add_courtier = character:studite_1 # Nicholas the Confessor, the deposed hegumen, held at Stoudios
			}
			every_courtier = {
				add_trait = devoted
				add_trait_xp = {
					trait = devoted
					value = { 20 80 }
				}
			}
			faith = {
				random_faith_holy_order = {
					limit = {
						leader = scope:monastic_leader
					}
					save_scope_as = studite
				}
			}
		}

dynastic_monks_gain_xp_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:puppet_or_actor } }
		scope:actor = { save_scope_as = puppet_or_actor }
	}
	every_courtier = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = devoted
			OR = {
				AND = {
					exists = scope:puppet_or_actor.dynasty
					dynasty ?= scope:puppet_or_actor.dynasty
				}
				is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
			}
		}
		add_trait_xp = {
			trait = devoted
			value = {
				value = 2
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_close_family_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
					}
					add = 2
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						house ?= scope:puppet_or_actor.house
					}
					add = 2
				}
				#increase for lease granting interaction
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:target
					}
					multiply = 2
				}
				#Increase for huge donation
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:huge_donation ?= yes
					}
					multiply = 2.5
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
#Holy Order patronage loss warning
grant_title_holy_order_patronage_warning_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			#Holy order is actually involved
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				any_patroned_holy_order = {
					leader.capital_county ?= {
    					save_temporary_scope_as = ho_capital_temp
    					any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = {
    						OR = {
    							is_in_list = target_titles
    							holder ?= {
    								target_is_same_character_or_above = scope:recipient
    							}
    						}
    					}
					}
    			}
			}
			#Duchy tier or higher is involved
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {	
					#Is duke
					highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
					#Will be duke and either already controls duchy or will
					AND = {
						any_in_list = {
							list = target_titles
							tier >= tier_duchy
						}
						OR = {
							scope:ho_capital_temp.holder ?= {
								target_is_same_character_or_above = scope:recipient
							}
							any_in_list = {
								list = target_titles
								this = scope:ho_capital_temp
							}
							AND = {
								scope:ho_capital_temp.holder.highest_held_title_tier = tier_county
								any_in_list = {
									list = target_titles
									tier >= tier_duchy
									any_de_jure_county = {
										this = scope:ho_capital_temp
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = holy_order_control_loss_warning_tt
	}
	#Potential holy order patronage loss warning
	if = {
		limit = {
			#No duchies involved
			NOR = {
				scope:recipient = {
					highest_held_title_tier > tier_county
				}
				any_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					tier > tier_county
				}
			}
			#But you are giving away Order capital
			scope:actor = {
				any_patroned_holy_order = {
					leader.capital_county ?= {
    					save_temporary_scope_as = ho_capital_temp
    					is_in_list = target_titles
					}
    			}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = potential_holy_order_control_loss_warning_tt
	}
}

monastic_belief_spreading_targeting_effect = {
	save_scope_as = holy_order_leader
	holy_order = {
		save_scope_as = holy_order
	}
	holy_order.order_tenet = {
		save_scope_as = order_tenet
	}
	rite = {
		save_scope_as = order_rite
	}
	#Make lists of targets
	holy_order = {
		#Spread Tenet to AI characters as personal tenet
		every_leased_title = {
			#leases' duchies' counties
			duchy ?= {
				every_de_jure_county_holder = {
					limit = {
						pam_monastic_tenet_spread_target_trigger = { ORDER_LEADER = scope:holy_order_leader }
					}
					add_to_list = personal_tenet_targets
				}
			}
			#Neighboring counties to leases
			county ?= {
				every_neighboring_county = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							holder ?= {
								pam_monastic_tenet_spread_target_trigger = { ORDER_LEADER = scope:holy_order_leader }
							}
						}
						holder = {
							add_to_list = personal_tenet_targets
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	#Change character tenets
	every_in_list = {
		list = personal_tenet_targets
		#Of AI
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
			}
			random = {
				chance = {
					value = {
						value = scope:holy_order_leader.learning
						multiply = 0.5
					}
					#Actually want tenet
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								any_desired_tenet = {
									selection_count = 97
									only_positive = yes
									threshold = 1
									this = scope:order_tenet
								}
							}
						}
						add = 0.1
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							any_desired_tenet = {
								selection_count = 1
								only_positive = yes
								this = scope:order_tenet
							}
						}
						multiply = 5
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							any_desired_tenet = {
								selection_count = 3
								only_positive = yes
								this = scope:order_tenet
							}
						}
						multiply = 3
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							any_desired_tenet = {
								selection_count = 6
								only_positive = yes
								this = scope:order_tenet
							}
						}
						multiply = 2
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							rite = {
								has_tenet_status = {
									tenet = scope:order_tenet
									status = core
								}
							}
						}
						multiply = 2
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							rite = {
								has_tenet_status = {
									tenet = scope:order_tenet
									status = permitted
								}
							}
						}
						multiply = 1.5
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							rite = {
								has_tenet_status = {
									tenet = scope:order_tenet
									status = prohibited
								}
							}
						}
						multiply = 0.25
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								capital_county.kingdom = scope:holy_order_leader.capital_county.kingdom
							}
						}
						multiply = 0.75
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								capital_county.empire = scope:holy_order_leader.capital_county.empire
							}
						}
						multiply = 0.75
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
						}
						multiply = 0.25
					}
				}
				add_to_list = order_tenet_accepted
			}
		}
	}
}

monastic_tenet_espousing_effect = {
	add_character_flag = {
		flag = mon_tenet_cooldown
		years = 5
	}
	#Need to convince at least someone, jeez...
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_in_list = {
					count >= 1
					list = order_tenet_accepted
					is_ai = yes
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_list = {
			list = personal_tenet_targets
			limit = {
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
				is_ai = yes
			}
			limit = {
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_duchy
				is_ai = yes
			}
			alternative_limit = {
				is_ai = yes
			}
			add_to_list = order_tenet_accepted
		}
	}
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = order_tenet_accepted_count
		value = list_size:order_tenet_accepted
	}
	

	#APPLY TO CHARACTERS SELECTED IN monastic_belief_spreading_targeting_effect
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = order_tenet_accepted
				count >= 1
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = order_tenet_accepted_list_tt
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		every_in_list = {
			list = order_tenet_accepted
			add_character_flag = free_tenet_change
			force_set_personal_tenet = scope:order_tenet
			remove_character_flag = free_tenet_change

		}
	}
	
	#players choose via interaction
	every_in_list = {
		list = personal_tenet_targets
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
		}
		save_scope_as = tenet_interaction_recipient
		run_interaction = {
			interaction = pam_evangelize_personal_tenet_interaction
			actor = scope:holy_order_leader
			recipient = scope:tenet_interaction_recipient
			execute_threshold = decline
		}
		add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
	}
	#give some correct rite courtiers piety
	custom_tooltip = espouse_beliefs_monks_piety_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		add_piety = medium_piety_gain
		every_courtier = {
			limit = {
				rite = scope:order_rite
				has_trait = devoted
			}
			random = {
				chance = {
					value = scope:holy_order_leader.learning
					multiply = 4
				}
				add_piety = medium_piety_gain
			}
		}
		#Set courtier rite to order rite
		every_courtier = {
			limit = {
				faith = scope:holy_order_leader.faith
				NOT = {
					rite = scope:order_rite
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = {
					value = scope:holy_order_leader.learning
					multiply = 4
				}
				set_character_rite = scope:holy_order_leader.rite
			}
		}
	}
	scope:holy_order_leader = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = devoted }
			add_trait_xp = {
				trait = devoted
				value = 5
			}
		}
	}

	#Inform their lease holders of what happened
	holy_order = {
		every_leased_title = {
			county.holder ?= {
				add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
			}
		}
	}
	faith = {
		every_faith_playable_ruler = {
			limit = {
				is_clergy = yes
				in_diplomatic_range = scope:holy_order_leader
			}
			add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
		}
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		every_in_list = {
			list = rulers_to_notify
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
			}
			save_scope_as = msg_receiver
			#Personal Tenet spread message
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_in_list = {
						list = order_tenet_accepted
						count > 2
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
				}
				ordered_in_list = {
					list = order_tenet_accepted
					order_by = highest_held_title_tier
					limit = {
						is_liege_or_above_of = scope:msg_receiver
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						OR = {
							house ?= scope:msg_receiver.house
							has_any_scripted_relation = scope:msg_receiver
						}
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						liege ?= scope:msg_receiver
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						top_liege ?= scope:msg_receiver
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						any_character_to_title_neighboring_county = {
						 	holder = scope:msg_receiver
						}
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = tenet_change_1
				}
				ordered_in_list = {
					list = order_tenet_accepted
					order_by = highest_held_title_tier
					limit = {
						is_liege_or_above_of = scope:msg_receiver
						NOR = {
							this = scope:tenet_change_1
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						OR = {
							house ?= scope:msg_receiver.house
							has_any_scripted_relation = scope:msg_receiver
						}
						NOR = {
							this = scope:tenet_change_1
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						liege ?= scope:msg_receiver
						NOR = {
							this = scope:tenet_change_1
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						top_liege ?= scope:msg_receiver
						NOR = {
							this = scope:tenet_change_1
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						any_character_to_title_neighboring_county = {
						 	holder = scope:msg_receiver
						}
						NOR = {
							this = scope:tenet_change_1
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					alternative_limit = {
						NOR = {
							this = scope:tenet_change_1
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = tenet_change_2
				}
				send_interface_message = {
					type = msg_order_espousing_beliefs
					title = msg_order_espousing_beliefs_title_tenet
					left_icon = scope:tenet_change_1
					right_icon = scope:holy_order_leader.primary_title
					custom_tooltip = order_spreading_tenet_tt
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					any_in_list = {
						list = order_tenet_accepted
						count = 2
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
				}
				random_in_list = {
					list = order_tenet_accepted
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = tenet_change_1
				}
				random_in_list = {
					list = order_tenet_accepted
					limit = {
						NOR = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
							this = scope:tenet_change_1
						}
					}
					save_scope_as = tenet_change_2
				}
				send_interface_message = {
					type = msg_order_espousing_beliefs
					title = msg_order_espousing_beliefs_title_tenet
					left_icon = scope:tenet_change_1
					right_icon = scope:holy_order_leader.primary_title
					custom_tooltip = order_spreading_tenet_tt_char_1
					custom_tooltip = order_spreading_tenet_tt_char_2
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					any_in_list = {
						list = order_tenet_accepted
						count = 1
						NOT = {
							this = scope:msg_receiver
						}
					}
				}
				random_in_list = {
					list = order_tenet_accepted
					save_scope_as = tenet_change_1
				}
				send_interface_message = {
					type = msg_order_espousing_beliefs
					title = msg_order_espousing_beliefs_title_tenet
					left_icon = scope:tenet_change_1
					right_icon = scope:holy_order_leader.primary_title
					custom_tooltip = order_spreading_tenet_tt_char_1
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

#Other effect where they gain monasteries and increase development

#Get monasteries where Rite and ruler tenet matches theirs
#Increase development in matching-rite duchies they lease in
#improve monk courtiers of leader
#Inform their lease holders of what happened
#Inform lease holders of other monasteries they had monasteries switched
monastic_lease_swapping_effect = {
	add_character_flag = {
		flag = mon_monastery_gain_cooldown
		years = 3
	}
	add_character_flag = {
		flag = just_swapped_lease
		days = 10
	}
	save_scope_as = holy_order_leader
	holy_order = {
		save_scope_as = holy_order
	}
	holy_order.order_tenet = {
		save_scope_as = order_tenet
	}
	rite = {
		save_scope_as = order_rite
	}
	faith = {
		random_faith_holy_order = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					this = scope:holy_order
				}
				any_leased_title = {
					monastic_lease_can_be_suborned_trigger = { ORDER = scope:holy_order }
				}
				scope:holy_order_leader.var:old_order ?= this
			}
			alternative_limit = {
				NOT = {
					this = scope:holy_order
				}
				any_leased_title = {
					monastic_lease_can_be_suborned_trigger = { ORDER = scope:holy_order }
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = target_order
			ordered_leased_title = {
				order_by = {
					value = county.development_level
					multiply = -1
				}
				limit = {
					monastic_lease_can_be_suborned_trigger = { ORDER = scope:holy_order }
					NOT = {
						county = scope:target_order.leader.capital_county
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = taken_monastery
			}
			#Capital monastery if only available
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						exists = scope:taken_monastery
					}
				}
				ordered_leased_title = {
					order_by = {
						value = county.development_level
						multiply = -1
					}
					limit = {
						monastic_lease_can_be_suborned_trigger = { ORDER = scope:holy_order }
					}
					save_scope_as = taken_monastery
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:taken_monastery
		}
		#Inform their lease holders of what is happening
		holy_order = {
			every_leased_title = {
				county.holder ?= {
					add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
				}
			}
		}
		faith.religious_head ?= {
			add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
		}
		rite.head_of_rite ?= {
			add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
		}
		scope:target_order = {
			every_leased_title = {
				county.holder ?= {
					add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
				}
			}
			leader.rite.head_of_rite ?= {
				add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
			}
		}
		scope:taken_monastery.county = {
			holder ?= {
				add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
			}
			clerical_region_title.holder ?= {
				add_to_list = rulers_to_notify
			}
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = rulers_to_notify
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
			}
			save_scope_as = msg_receiver
	
			#Normal message
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_order = {
						any_leased_title = {
							NOT = {
								this = scope:taken_monastery
							}
						}
					}
				}
				send_interface_message = {
					type = msg_order_took_over_monastery
					title = msg_order_took_over_monastery.t
					left_icon = scope:holy_order_leader.primary_title
					right_icon = scope:target_order.leader.primary_title
					custom_tooltip = order_took_over_monastery_tt
					if = {
						limit = {
							#Rite mismatch caused this
							scope:target_order.leader.rite ?= {
								NOT = {
									this = scope:order_rite
								}
								OR = {
									NOT = {
										scope:taken_monastery.county.clerical_region_title.holder.rite ?= scope:target_order.leader.rite
									}
									NOT = {
										scope:taken_monastery.county.holder.rite ?= this
									}
								}
							}
						}
						scope:target_order.leader.rite = { save_scope_as = target_rite }
						custom_tooltip = monastic_spreading_rite_tt
					}
					#Influence of patron or puppeteer
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							scope:taken_monastery.county = {
								OR = {
									clerical_region_title.holder ?= {
										OR = {
											scope:holy_order.holy_order_patron ?= this
											scope:holy_order_leader.puppeteer ?= this
											any_personal_tenet = {
												this = scope:order_tenet
											}
										}
									}
									holder ?= {
										OR = {
											scope:holy_order.holy_order_patron ?= this
											scope:holy_order_leader.puppeteer ?= this
											any_personal_tenet = {
												this = scope:order_tenet
											}
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:taken_monastery.county.clerical_region_title.holder ?= {
									OR = {
										scope:holy_order.holy_order_patron ?= this
										scope:holy_order_leader.puppeteer ?= this
										any_personal_tenet = {
											this = scope:order_tenet
										}
									}
								}
							}
							scope:taken_monastery.county.clerical_region_title.holder = {
								save_scope_as = instigator
							}
						}
						else = {
							scope:taken_monastery.county.holder ?= {
								save_scope_as = instigator
							}
						}
						custom_tooltip = monastic_spreading_instigated_tt
					}
				}
			}
			#Order destroying message
			else = {
				send_interface_message = {
					type = msg_order_took_over_monastery
					title = msg_order_took_over_other_order.t
					left_icon = scope:holy_order_leader.primary_title
					right_icon = scope:target_order.leader.primary_title
					custom_tooltip = order_took_over_capital_monastery_tt
					if = {
						limit = {
							#Rite mismatch caused this
							scope:target_order.leader.rite ?= {
								NOT = {
									this = scope:order_rite
								}
								OR = {
									NOT = {
										scope:taken_monastery.county.clerical_region_title.holder.rite ?= scope:target_order.leader.rite
									}
									NOT = {
										scope:taken_monastery.county.holder.rite ?= this
									}
								}
							}
						}
						scope:target_order.leader.rite = { save_scope_as = target_rite }
						custom_tooltip = monastic_spreading_rite_tt
					}
					#Influence of patron or puppeteer
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							scope:taken_monastery.county = {
								OR = {
									clerical_region_title.holder ?= {
										OR = {
											scope:holy_order.holy_order_patron ?= this
											scope:holy_order_leader.puppeteer ?= this
											any_personal_tenet = {
												this = scope:order_tenet
											}
										}
									}
									holder ?= {
										OR = {
											scope:holy_order.holy_order_patron ?= this
											scope:holy_order_leader.puppeteer ?= this
											any_personal_tenet = {
												this = scope:order_tenet
											}
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:taken_monastery.county.clerical_region_title.holder ?= {
									OR = {
										scope:holy_order.holy_order_patron ?= this
										scope:holy_order_leader.puppeteer ?= this
										any_personal_tenet = {
											this = scope:order_tenet
										}
									}
								}
							}
							scope:taken_monastery.county.clerical_region_title.holder = {
								save_scope_as = instigator
							}
						}
						else = {
							scope:taken_monastery.county.holder ?= {
								save_scope_as = instigator
							}
						}
						custom_tooltip = monastic_spreading_instigated_tt
					}
				}
			}
			
		}
		scope:taken_monastery = {
			revoke_lease = yes
			lease_out_to_holy_order = scope:holy_order
		}
		#Monk courtiers get better
		add_trait_xp = {
			trait = devoted
			value = 10
		}
		every_courtier = {
			limit = {
				has_trait = devoted
			}
			add_trait_xp = {
				trait = devoted
				value = 5
			}
		}
	}
}
